name: Abomasnow
description: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Abomasnow-Mega
description: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Abra
description: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

name: Absol
description: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Absol-Mega
description: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Accelgor
description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Aegislash
description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aegislash-Blade
description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aerodactyl
description: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Aerodactyl-Mega
description: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Aggron
description: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

name: Aggron-Mega
description: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

name: Aipom
description: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Alakazam
description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

name: Alakazam-Mega
description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

name: Alcremie
description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Alcremie-Gmax
description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Alomomola
description: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

name: Altaria
description: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

name: Altaria-Mega
description: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

name: Amaura
description: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Ambipom
description: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

name: Amoonguss
description: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Ampharos
description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Ampharos-Mega
description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Annihilape
description: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Anorith
description: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

name: Appletun
description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Appletun-Gmax
description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Applin
description: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Araquanid
description: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Araquanid-Totem
description: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Arbok
description: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

name: Arboliva
description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Arcanine
description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Arcanine-Hisui
description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Archaludon
description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Archen
description: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops
description: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Arctibax
description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Arctovish
description: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

name: Arctozolt
description: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

name: Ariados
description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Armaldo
description: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

name: Armarouge
description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Aromatisse
description: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Aron
description: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

name: Arrokuda
description: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Articuno
description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

name: Articuno-Galar
description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

name: Audino
description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Audino-Mega
description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Aurorus
description: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Avalugg
description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Avalugg-Hisui
description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Axew
description: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

name: Azelf
description: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

name: Azumarill
description: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

name: Azurill
description: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

name: Bagon
description: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

name: Baltoy
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Banette
description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Banette-Mega
description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Barbaracle
description: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

name: Barboach
description: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Barraskewda
description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Basculegion
description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Basculegion-F
description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Basculin
description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Basculin-Blue-Striped
description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Basculin-White-Striped
description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Bastiodon
description: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

name: Baxcalibur
description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: Bayleef
description: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Beartic
description: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Beautifly
description: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

name: Beedrill
description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Beedrill-Mega
description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Beheeyem
description: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

name: Beldum
description: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

name: Bellibolt
description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Bellossom
description: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Bellsprout
description: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

name: Bergmite
description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Bewear
description: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bibarel
description: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

name: Bidoof
description: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

name: Binacle
description: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

name: Bisharp
description: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Blacephalon
description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Blastoise
description: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Blastoise-Gmax
description: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Blastoise-Mega
description: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Blaziken
description: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

name: Blaziken-Mega
description: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

name: Blipbug
description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Blissey
description: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

name: Blitzle
description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Boldore
description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Boltund
description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Bombirdier
description: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

name: Bonsly
description: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

name: Bouffalant
description: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Bounsweet
description: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Braixen
description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Brambleghast
description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Bramblin
description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Braviary
description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Braviary-Hisui
description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Breloom
description: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

name: Brionne
description: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

name: Bronzong
description: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Bronzor
description: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Brute Bonnet
description: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

name: Bruxish
description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Budew
description: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

name: Buizel
description: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Bulbasaur
description: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Buneary
description: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

name: Bunnelby
description: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Burmy
description: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

name: Butterfree
description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Butterfree-Gmax
description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Buzzwole
description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Cacnea
description: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

name: Cacturne
description: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

name: Calyrex
description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Calyrex-Ice
description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Calyrex-Shadow
description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Camerupt
description: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

name: Camerupt-Mega
description: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

name: Capsakid
description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Carbink
description: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Carkol
description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Carnivine
description: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

name: Carracosta
description: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Carvanha
description: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Cascoon
description: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

name: Castform
description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Castform-Rainy
description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Castform-Snowy
description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Castform-Sunny
description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Celebi
description: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Celesteela
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Centiskorch
description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Centiskorch-Gmax
description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Ceruledge
description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Cetitan
description: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

name: Cetoddle
description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

name: Chandelure
description: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

name: Chansey
description: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

name: Charcadet
description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Charizard
description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Charizard-Gmax
description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Charizard-Mega-X
description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Charizard-Mega-Y
description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Charjabug
description: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Charmander
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Chatot
description: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Cherrim
description: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

name: Cherrim-Sunshine
description: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

name: Cherubi
description: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

name: Chesnaught
description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Chespin
description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

name: Chewtle
description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Chien-Pao
description: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

name: Chikorita
description: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

name: Chimchar
description: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Chimecho
description: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Chingling
description: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

name: Chi-Yu
description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: Cinccino
description: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Cinderace
description: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Cinderace-Gmax
description: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Clamperl
description: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

name: Clauncher
description: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

name: Clawitzer
description: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

name: Claydol
description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Clefable
description: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

name: Clefairy
description: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

name: Cleffa
description: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

name: Clobbopus
description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Clodsire
description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Cloyster
description: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Coalossal
description: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Coalossal-Gmax
description: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Cobalion
description: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

name: Cofagrigus
description: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Combee
description: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

name: Combusken
description: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

name: Comfey
description: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

name: Conkeldurr
description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Copperajah
description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Copperajah-Gmax
description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Corphish
description: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Corsola
description: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

name: Corsola-Galar
description: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

name: Corviknight
description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

name: Corviknight-Gmax
description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

name: Corvisquire
description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

name: Cosmoem
description: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

name: Cosmog
description: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

name: Cottonee
description: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Crabominable
description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Crabrawler
description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Cradily
description: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

name: Cramorant
description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Cramorant-Gorging
description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Cramorant-Gulping
description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Cranidos
description: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Crawdaunt
description: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Cresselia
description: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

name: Croagunk
description: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

name: Crobat
description: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

name: Crocalor
description: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

name: Croconaw
description: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

name: Crustle
description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

name: Cryogonal
description: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Cubchoo
description: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Cubone
description: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Cufant
description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Cursola
description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Cutiefly
description: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Cyclizar
description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Cyndaquil
description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Dachsbun
description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Darkrai
description: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Darmanitan
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Darmanitan-Galar
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Darmanitan-Galar-Zen
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Darmanitan-Zen
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dartrix
description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Darumaka
description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: Darumaka-Galar
description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: Decidueye
description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Decidueye-Hisui
description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Dedenne
description: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Deerling
description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Deino
description: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Delcatty
description: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.

name: Delibird
description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

name: Delphox
description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Deoxys
description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

name: Deoxys-Attack
description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

name: Deoxys-Defense
description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

name: Deoxys-Speed
description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

name: Dewgong
description: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

name: Dewott
description: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Dewpider
description: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Dhelmise
description: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Dialga
description: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

name: Dialga-Origin
description: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

name: Diancie
description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Diancie-Mega
description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Diggersby
description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Diglett
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Diglett-Alola
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dipplin
description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: Ditto
description: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

name: Dodrio
description: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

name: Doduo
description: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

name: Dolliv
description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Dondozo
description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Donphan
description: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

name: Dottler
description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Doublade
description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Dracovish
description: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

name: Dracozolt
description: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Dragalge
description: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

name: Dragapult
description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Dragonair
description: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

name: Dragonite
description: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

name: Drakloak
description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Drampa
description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Drapion
description: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

name: Dratini
description: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

name: Drednaw
description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Drednaw-Gmax
description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Dreepy
description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drifblim
description: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

name: Drifloon
description: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drilbur
description: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Drizzile
description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Drowzee
description: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

name: Druddigon
description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Dubwool
description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Ducklett
description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Dugtrio
description: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

name: Dugtrio-Alola
description: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

name: Dunsparce
description: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

name: Duosion
description: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Duraludon
description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Duraludon-Gmax
description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Durant
description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Dusclops
description: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

name: Dusknoir
description: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

name: Duskull
description: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

name: Dustox
description: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Dwebble
description: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Eelektrik
description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Eevee
description: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

name: Eevee-Gmax
description: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

name: Eevee-Starter
description: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

name: Eiscue
description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Eiscue-Noice
description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Ekans
description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Eldegoss
description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Electabuzz
description: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

name: Electivire
description: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

name: Electrike
description: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Electrode
description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Electrode-Hisui
description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Elekid
description: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

name: Elgyem
description: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

name: Emboar
description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Emolga
description: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Empoleon
description: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

name: Enamorus
description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Enamorus-Therian
description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Entei
description: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

name: Escavalier
description: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

name: Espathra
description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Espeon
description: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

name: Espurr
description: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Eternatus
description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Eternatus-Eternamax
description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Excadrill
description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Exeggcute
description: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
description: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Exeggutor-Alola
description: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Exploud
description: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Falinks
description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Farfetch’d
description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

name: Farfetch’d-Galar
description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

name: Farigiraf
description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

name: Fearow
description: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

name: Feebas
description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Fennekin
description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Feraligatr
description: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

name: Ferroseed
description: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
description: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Fezandipiti
description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

name: Fidough
description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

name: Finizen
description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Finneon
description: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

name: Flaaffy
description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Flabébé
description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Flamigo
description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Flapple
description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Flapple-Gmax
description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Flareon
description: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fletchinder
description: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Fletchling
description: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

name: Flittle
description: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

name: Floatzel
description: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

name: Floette
description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Floette-Eternal
description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Floragato
description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Florges
description: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Flutter Mane
description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

name: Flygon
description: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

name: Fomantis
description: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

name: Foongus
description: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Forretress
description: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Fraxure
description: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

name: Frigibax
description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: Frillish
description: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Froakie
description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

name: Froslass
description: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

name: Frosmoth
description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Fuecoco
description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Furfrou
description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Furret
description: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

name: Gabite
description: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

name: Gallade
description: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Gallade-Mega
description: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Galvantula
description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Garbodor
description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Garbodor-Gmax
description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Garchomp
description: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

name: Garchomp-Mega
description: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

name: Gardevoir
description: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Gardevoir-Mega
description: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Garganacl
description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Gastly
description: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

name: Gastrodon
description: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

name: Genesect
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Genesect-Burn
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Genesect-Chill
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Genesect-Douse
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Genesect-Shock
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Gengar
description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Gengar-Gmax
description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Gengar-Mega
description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Geodude
description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

name: Geodude-Alola
description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

name: Gholdengo
description: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Gible
description: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

name: Gigalith
description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Girafarig
description: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

name: Giratina
description: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

name: Giratina-Origin
description: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

name: Glaceon
description: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Glalie
description: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

name: Glalie-Mega
description: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

name: Glameow
description: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Glastrier
description: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Gligar
description: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Glimmet
description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Glimmora
description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Gliscor
description: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Gloom
description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Gogoat
description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Golbat
description: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

name: Goldeen
description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Golduck
description: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

name: Golem
description: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

name: Golem-Alola
description: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

name: Golett
description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golisopod
description: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

name: Golurk
description: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

name: Goodra
description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Goodra-Hisui
description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Goomy
description: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Gorebyss
description: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

name: Gossifleur
description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Gothita
description: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothitelle
description: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

name: Gothorita
description: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

name: Gouging Fire
description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

name: Gourgeist
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist-Large
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist-Small
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist-Super
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Grafaiai
description: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Granbull
description: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Grapploct
description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Graveler
description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

name: Graveler-Alola
description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

name: Great Tusk
description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

name: Greavard
description: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Greedent
description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Greninja
description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Greninja-Bond
description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Grimer
description: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Grimer-Alola
description: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Grimmsnarl-Gmax
description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Grookey
description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Grotle
description: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Groudon
description: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

name: Groudon-Primal
description: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

name: Grovyle
description: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

name: Growlithe
description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Growlithe-Hisui
description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Grubbin
description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Grumpig
description: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

name: Gulpin
description: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

name: Gumshoos
description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Gumshoos-Totem
description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Gurdurr
description: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Guzzlord
description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Gyarados
description: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

name: Gyarados-Mega
description: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

name: Hakamo-o
description: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Happiny
description: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

name: Hariyama
description: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Hatenna
description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hatterene
description: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Hatterene-Gmax
description: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Hattrem
description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Haunter
description: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

name: Hawlucha
description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Haxorus
description: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

name: Heatmor
description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Heatran
description: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

name: Heliolisk
description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Helioptile
description: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heracross
description: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Heracross-Mega
description: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Herdier
description: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Hippopotas
description: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
description: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.
