name: Hitmonchan
description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmontop
description: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

name: Honchkrow
description: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

name: Honedge
description: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Ho-Oh
description: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

name: Hoopa
description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Hoopa-Unbound
description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Hoothoot
description: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

name: Hoppip
description: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

name: Horsea
description: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Houndoom
description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Houndoom-Mega
description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Houndour
description: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndstone
description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Huntail
description: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

name: Hydrapple
description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

name: Hydreigon
description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Hypno
description: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

name: Igglybuff
description: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

name: Illumise
description: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

name: Impidimp
description: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Incineroar
description: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

name: Indeedee
description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Indeedee-F
description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Infernape
description: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Inkay
description: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Inteleon
description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Inteleon-Gmax
description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Iron Boulder
description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Bundle
description: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

name: Iron Crown
description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Iron Hands
description: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

name: Iron Jugulis
description: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: Iron Leaves
description: Ecology under analysis.

name: Iron Moth
description: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

name: Iron Thorns
description: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: Iron Treads
description: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

name: Iron Valiant
description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Ivysaur
description: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

name: Jangmo-o
description: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

name: Jellicent
description: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Jigglypuff
description: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

name: Jirachi
description: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

name: Jolteon
description: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

name: Joltik
description: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

name: Jumpluff
description: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

name: Jynx
description: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

name: Kabuto
description: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

name: Kabutops
description: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

name: Kadabra
description: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

name: Kakuna
description: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

name: Kangaskhan
description: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Kangaskhan-Mega
description: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Karrablast
description: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Kartana
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kecleon
description: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

name: Keldeo
description: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

name: Keldeo-Resolute
description: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

name: Kilowattrel
description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Kingambit
description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Kingdra
description: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

name: Kingler
description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Kingler-Gmax
description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Kirlia
description: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

name: Klang
description: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

name: Klawf
description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Kleavor
description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Klefki
description: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

name: Klink
description: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

name: Klinklang
description: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

name: Koffing
description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Komala
description: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Kommo-o
description: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Kommo-o-Totem
description: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Krabby
description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kricketot
description: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

name: Kricketune
description: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Krokorok
description: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

name: Krookodile
description: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

name: Kubfu
description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Kyogre
description: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

name: Kyogre-Primal
description: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

name: Kyurem
description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

name: Kyurem-Black
description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

name: Kyurem-White
description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

name: Lairon
description: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

name: Lampent
description: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Landorus
description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Landorus-Therian
description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Lanturn
description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Lapras-Gmax
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Larvesta
description: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Larvitar
description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Latias
description: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

name: Latias-Mega
description: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

name: Latios
description: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

name: Latios-Mega
description: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

name: Leafeon
description: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Leavanny
description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Lechonk
description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Ledian
description: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Ledyba
description: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Lickilicky
description: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

name: Lickitung
description: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

name: Liepard
description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Lileep
description: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Lilligant
description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Lilligant-Hisui
description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Lillipup
description: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Linoone
description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Linoone-Galar
description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Litleo
description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Litten
description: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

name: Litwick
description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lokix
description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Lombre
description: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Lopunny
description: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

name: Lopunny-Mega
description: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

name: Lotad
description: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Loudred
description: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Lucario
description: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

name: Lucario-Mega
description: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

name: Ludicolo
description: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Lugia
description: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

name: Lumineon
description: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

name: Lunala
description: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

name: Lunatone
description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Lurantis
description: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Lurantis-Totem
description: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Luvdisc
description: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

name: Luxio
description: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

name: Luxray
description: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

name: Lycanroc
description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Lycanroc-Dusk
description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Lycanroc-Midnight
description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Mabosstiff
description: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

name: Machamp
description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

name: Machamp-Gmax
description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

name: Machoke
description: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

name: Machop
description: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

name: Magby
description: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

name: Magcargo
description: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

name: Magearna
description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Magearna-Original
description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Magikarp
description: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

name: Magmar
description: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

name: Magmortar
description: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

name: Magnemite
description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
description: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

name: Magnezone
description: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

name: Makuhita
description: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Malamar
description: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Mamoswine
description: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

name: Manaphy
description: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

name: Mandibuzz
description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Manectric
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Manectric-Mega
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Mankey
description: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

name: Mantine
description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Mantyke
description: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

name: Maractus
description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Mareanie
description: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

name: Mareep
description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

name: Marill
description: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

name: Marowak
description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Marowak-Alola
description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Marowak-Alola-Totem
description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Marshadow
description: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

name: Marshtomp
description: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

name: Maschiff
description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

name: Masquerain
description: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

name: Mawile
description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Mawile-Mega
description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Medicham
description: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

name: Medicham-Mega
description: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

name: Meditite
description: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

name: Meganium
description: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

name: Melmetal
description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Melmetal-Gmax
description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Meloetta
description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Meloetta-Pirouette
description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Meltan
description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Meowscarada
description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Meowstic
description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Meowstic-F
description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Meowth
description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Meowth-Alola
description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Meowth-Galar
description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Meowth-Gmax
description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Mesprit
description: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

name: Metagross
description: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

name: Metagross-Mega
description: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

name: Metang
description: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

name: Metapod
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Mew
description: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

name: Mewtwo
description: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mewtwo-Mega-X
description: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mewtwo-Mega-Y
description: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mienfoo
description: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Mightyena
description: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

name: Milcery
description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Milotic
description: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

name: Miltank
description: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Mime Jr.
description: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

name: Mimikyu
description: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Mimikyu-Busted
description: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Mimikyu-Busted-Totem
description: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Mimikyu-Totem
description: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Minccino
description: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Minior
description: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Minior-Meteor
description: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Minun
description: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

name: Misdreavus
description: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Mismagius
description: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

name: Moltres
description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Moltres-Galar
description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Monferno
description: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

name: Morelull
description: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

name: Morgrem
description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Morpeko
description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Morpeko-Hangry
description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Mothim
description: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

name: Mr. Mime
description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Mr. Mime-Galar
description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Mr. Rime
description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Mudbray
description: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudkip
description: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

name: Mudsdale
description: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Muk
description: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Muk-Alola
description: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Munchlax
description: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Munkidori
description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

name: Munna
description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Murkrow
description: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Musharna
description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Nacli
description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

name: Naganadel
description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Natu
description: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Necrozma
description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Necrozma-Dawn-Wings
description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Necrozma-Dusk-Mane
description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Necrozma-Ultra
description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Nickit
description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Nidoking
description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

name: Nidoqueen
description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

name: Nidoran-F
description: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.

name: Nidoran-M
description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

name: Nidorina
description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

name: Nidorino
description: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

name: Nihilego
description: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

name: Nincada
description: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

name: Ninetales
description: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

name: Ninetales-Alola
description: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

name: Ninjask
description: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Noctowl
description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Noibat
description: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noivern
description: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Nosepass
description: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

name: Numel
description: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

name: Nuzleaf
description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Nymble
description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Obstagoon
description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Octillery
description: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

name: Oddish
description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Ogerpon
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Cornerstone
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Cornerstone-Tera
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Hearthflame
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Hearthflame-Tera
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Teal-Tera
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Wellspring
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon-Wellspring-Tera
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Okidogi
description: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

name: Omanyte
description: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

name: Omastar
description: Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

name: Onix
description: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

name: Oranguru
description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Orbeetle
description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Orbeetle-Gmax
description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Oricorio
description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Oricorio-Pa'u
description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Oricorio-Pom-Pom
description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Oricorio-Sensu
description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Orthworm
description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Oshawott
description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Overqwil
description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Pachirisu
description: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

name: Palkia
description: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

name: Palkia-Origin
description: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

name: Palossand
description: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Palpitoad
description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Pancham
description: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Pangoro
description: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Panpour
description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Pansage
description: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Pansear
description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Paras
description: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

name: Parasect
description: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

name: Passimian
description: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Patrat
description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Pawmi
description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Pawniard
description: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Pecharunt
description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

name: Pelipper
description: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

name: Perrserker
description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Persian
description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Persian-Alola
description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Petilil
description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Phanpy
description: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

name: Phantump
description: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Pheromosa
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Phione
description: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

name: Pichu
description: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

name: Pichu-Spiky-eared
description: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

name: Pidgeot
description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

name: Pidgeot-Mega
description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

name: Pidgeotto
description: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgey
description: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

name: Pidove
description: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Pignite
description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Pikachu
description: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

name: Pikachu-Alola
description: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
