name: Pikipek
description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Piloswine
description: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

name: Pincurchin
description: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Pineco
description: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Pinsir
description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Pinsir-Mega
description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Piplup
description: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

name: Plusle
description: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

name: Poipole
description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Politoed
description: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Poliwag
description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Poliwhirl
description: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

name: Poliwrath
description: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

name: Poltchageist
description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: Poltchageist-Artisan
description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: Polteageist
description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Polteageist-Antique
description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Ponyta
description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

name: Ponyta-Galar
description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

name: Poochyena
description: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

name: Popplio
description: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

name: Porygon
description: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

name: Porygon2
description: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

name: Porygon-Z
description: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

name: Primarina
description: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

name: Primeape
description: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

name: Prinplup
description: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Probopass
description: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

name: Psyduck
description: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Pumpkaboo-Large
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Pumpkaboo-Small
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Pumpkaboo-Super
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Pupitar
description: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

name: Purrloin
description: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Purugly
description: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

name: Pyroar
description: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Pyukumuku
description: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Quagsire
description: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Quaquaval
description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Quaxly
description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Quilava
description: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Quilladin
description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

name: Qwilfish
description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Qwilfish-Hisui
description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Raboot
description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Rabsca
description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Raging Bolt
description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

name: Raichu
description: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

name: Raichu-Alola
description: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

name: Raikou
description: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

name: Ralts
description: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Rampardos
description: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

name: Rapidash
description: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

name: Rapidash-Galar
description: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

name: Raticate
description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Raticate-Alola
description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Raticate-Alola-Totem
description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Rattata
description: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Rattata-Alola
description: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Rayquaza
description: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

name: Rayquaza-Mega
description: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

name: Regice
description: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

name: Regidrago
description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Regieleki
description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

name: Regigigas
description: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

name: Regirock
description: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

name: Registeel
description: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

name: Relicanth
description: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

name: Rellor
description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Remoraid
description: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

name: Reshiram
description: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Reuniclus
description: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Revavroom
description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Rhydon
description: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

name: Rhyperior
description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

name: Ribombee
description: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Ribombee-Totem
description: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Rillaboom
description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Rillaboom-Gmax
description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Riolu
description: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

name: Roaring Moon
description: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

name: Rockruff
description: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Rockruff-Dusk
description: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Roggenrola
description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Rolycoly
description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Rookidee
description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Roselia
description: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

name: Roserade
description: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

name: Rotom
description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Rotom-Fan
description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Rotom-Frost
description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Rotom-Heat
description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Rotom-Mow
description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Rotom-Wash
description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Rowlet
description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Rufflet
description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Runerigus
description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Sableye
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Sableye-Mega
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Salamence
description: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

name: Salamence-Mega
description: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

name: Salandit
description: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
description: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Salazzle-Totem
description: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Samurott
description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Samurott-Hisui
description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Sandaconda
description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Sandaconda-Gmax
description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Sandile
description: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

name: Sandshrew
description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandshrew-Alola
description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Sandslash-Alola
description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Sandygast
description: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

name: Sawk
description: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

name: Sawsbuck
description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

name: Scatterbug
description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Sceptile
description: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

name: Sceptile-Mega
description: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

name: Scizor
description: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Scizor-Mega
description: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Scolipede
description: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

name: Scorbunny
description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Scovillain
description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Scrafty
description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Scraggy
description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scream Tail
description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: Scyther
description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Seadra
description: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

name: Seaking
description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Sealeo
description: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

name: Seedot
description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Seel
description: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Seismitoad
description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Sentret
description: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

name: Serperior
description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Servine
description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Seviper
description: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

name: Sewaddle
description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Sharpedo
description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Sharpedo-Mega
description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Shaymin
description: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Shaymin-Sky
description: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Shedinja
description: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

name: Shelgon
description: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

name: Shellder
description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Shellos
description: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

name: Shelmet
description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Shieldon
description: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

name: Shiftry
description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Shiinotic
description: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

name: Shinx
description: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

name: Shroodle
description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Shroomish
description: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

name: Shuckle
description: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Shuppet
description: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

name: Sigilyph
description: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Silcoon
description: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

name: Silicobra
description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Silvally
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Bug
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Dark
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Dragon
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Electric
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Fairy
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Fighting
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Fire
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Flying
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Ghost
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Grass
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Ground
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Ice
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Poison
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Psychic
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Rock
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Steel
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally-Water
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Simipour
description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Simisage
description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Simisear
description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Sinistcha
description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

name: Sinistcha-Masterpiece
description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

name: Sinistea
description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Sinistea-Antique
description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Sirfetch’d
description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Skarmory
description: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Skeledirge
description: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

name: Skiddo
description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Skiploom
description: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

name: Skitty
description: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

name: Skorupi
description: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

name: Skrelp
description: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

name: Skuntank
description: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

name: Skwovet
description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Slaking
description: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

name: Slakoth
description: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

name: Sliggoo
description: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Sliggoo-Hisui
description: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Slither Wing
description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

name: Slowbro
description: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

name: Slowbro-Galar
description: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

name: Slowbro-Mega
description: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

name: Slowking
description: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

name: Slowking-Galar
description: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

name: Slowpoke
description: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

name: Slowpoke-Galar
description: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

name: Slugma
description: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

name: Slurpuff
description: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Smeargle
description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Smoliv
description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Smoochum
description: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

name: Sneasel
description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Sneasel-Hisui
description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Sneasler
description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Snivy
description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Snom
description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Snorlax
description: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Snorlax-Gmax
description: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Snorunt
description: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

name: Snover
description: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Snubbull
description: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Sobble
description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Solgaleo
description: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

name: Solosis
description: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Solrock
description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Spearow
description: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

name: Spectrier
description: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

name: Spewpa
description: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Spheal
description: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

name: Spidops
description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Spinarak
description: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Spinda
description: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

name: Spiritomb
description: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Spoink
description: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

name: Sprigatito
description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Spritzee
description: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Squirtle
description: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Stakataka
description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Stantler
description: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Staraptor
description: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

name: Staravia
description: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

name: Starly
description: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

name: Starmie
description: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Staryu
description: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Steelix
description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

name: Steelix-Mega
description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

name: Steenee
description: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Stonjourner
description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Stoutland
description: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Stufful
description: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Stunfisk
description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Stunfisk-Galar
description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Stunky
description: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

name: Sudowoodo
description: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Suicune
description: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

name: Sunflora
description: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

name: Sunkern
description: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

name: Surskit
description: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

name: Swablu
description: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

name: Swadloon
description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Swalot
description: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

name: Swampert
description: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

name: Swampert-Mega
description: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

name: Swanna
description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Swellow
description: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

name: Swinub
description: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Swirlix
description: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Swoobat
description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Sylveon
description: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Tadbulb
description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Taillow
description: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

name: Talonflame
description: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

name: Tandemaus
description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Tangela
description: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

name: Tangrowth
description: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

name: Tapu Bulu
description: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Fini
description: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Tapu Koko
description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Tapu Lele
description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Tarountula
description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

name: Tauros
description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

name: Tauros-Paldea-Aqua
description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

name: Tauros-Paldea-Blaze
description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

name: Tauros-Paldea-Combat
description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

name: Teddiursa
description: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Tentacool
description: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

name: Tentacruel
description: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

name: Tepig
description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Terapagos
description: It's thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Terapagos-Stellar
description: It's thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Terapagos-Terastal
description: It's thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Terrakion
description: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

name: Thievul
description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Throh
description: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

name: Thundurus
description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Thundurus-Therian
description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Thwackey
description: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

name: Timburr
description: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Ting-Lu
description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

name: Tinkatink
description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkaton
description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Tinkatuff
description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Tirtouga
description: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Toedscool
description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: Toedscruel
description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: Togedemaru
description: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Togedemaru-Totem
description: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Togekiss
description: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

name: Togepi
description: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
description: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

name: Torchic
description: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

name: Torkoal
description: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Tornadus
description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Tornadus-Therian
description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Torracat
description: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

name: Torterra
description: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

name: Totodile
description: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

name: Toucannon
description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Toxapex
description: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

name: Toxel
description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxicroak
description: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

name: Toxtricity
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity-Gmax
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity-Low-Key
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity-Low-Key-Gmax
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Tranquill
description: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Trapinch
description: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Treecko
description: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

name: Trevenant
description: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Tropius
description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Trubbish
description: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Trumbeak
description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Tsareena
description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Turtonator
description: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Turtwig
description: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

name: Tympole
description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

name: Tynamo
description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Type: Null
description: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Typhlosion
description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Typhlosion-Hisui
description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Tyranitar
description: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

name: Tyranitar-Mega
description: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

name: Tyrantrum
description: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Tyrogue
description: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Tyrunt
description: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Umbreon
description: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Unfezant
description: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Unown
description: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

name: Ursaluna
description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Ursaluna-Bloodmoon
description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Ursaring
description: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Urshifu
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Urshifu-Gmax
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Urshifu-Rapid-Strike
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Urshifu-Rapid-Strike-Gmax
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Uxie
description: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

name: Vanillish
description: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanillite
description: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanilluxe
description: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Vaporeon
description: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

name: Varoom
description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Veluza
description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

name: Venipede
description: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

name: Venomoth
description: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

name: Venonat
description: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

name: Venusaur
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Venusaur-Gmax
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Venusaur-Mega
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Vespiquen
description: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

name: Vibrava
description: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

name: Victini
description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Victreebel
description: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

name: Vigoroth
description: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

name: Vikavolt
description: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Vikavolt-Totem
description: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Vileplume
description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Virizion
description: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

name: Vivillon
description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Vivillon-Fancy
description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Vivillon-Pokeball
description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Volbeat
description: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Volcanion
description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Volcarona
description: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Voltorb
description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Voltorb-Hisui
description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Vullaby
description: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Vulpix
description: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

name: Vulpix-Alola
description: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

name: Wailmer
description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Wailord
description: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

name: Walking Wake
description: Ecology under research.

name: Walrein
description: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

name: Wartortle
description: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Watchog
description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Wattrel
description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Weavile
description: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

name: Weedle
description: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

name: Weepinbell
description: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

name: Weezing
description: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

name: Weezing-Galar
description: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

name: Whimsicott
description: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Whirlipede
description: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

name: Whiscash
description: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

name: Whismur
description: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

name: Wigglytuff
description: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

name: Wiglett
description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wimpod
description: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

name: Wingull
description: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

name: Wishiwashi
description: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Wishiwashi-School
description: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Wobbuffet
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Wo-Chien
description: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

name: Woobat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Wooloo
description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Wooper
description: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Wooper-Paldea
description: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Wormadam
description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wormadam-Sandy
description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wormadam-Trash
description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wugtrio
description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Wurmple
description: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

name: Wynaut
description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Wyrdeer
description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Xatu
description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Xerneas
description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Xerneas-Neutral
description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Xurkitree
description: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Yamask
description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Yamask-Galar
description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Yamper
description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Yanma
description: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Yanmega
description: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

name: Yungoos
description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Yveltal
description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Zacian
description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zacian-Crowned
description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zamazenta
description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Zamazenta-Crowned
description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Zangoose
description: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

name: Zapdos
description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Zapdos-Galar
description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Zarude
description: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Zarude-Dada
description: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Zebstrika
description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Zekrom
description: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

name: Zeraora
description: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

name: Zigzagoon
description: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

name: Zigzagoon-Galar
description: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

name: Zoroark
description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Zoroark-Hisui
description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Zorua
description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zorua-Hisui
description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zubat
description: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

name: Zweilous
description: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Zygarde
description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde-10%
description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde-Complete
description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
